title: Browser project calls
responsibility: Expose project, membership, invitation and GitHub connection calls for the signed-in browser.

inputs.name: invitationLink.origin
inputs.description: The site origin (scheme, host and optional port) that the invite path is appended to; it sets the scheme, host and port of every generated link. It is concatenated as-is, with no trimming, validation or trailing-slash removal, so a trailing '/' yields '//invite'.

inputs.name: invitationLink.invitation
inputs.description: The Invitation whose id and projectId become the two encoded path segments; only those fields are read, so the code and expiresAt never appear in the link. Nothing validates the values: a null or undefined invitation throws a TypeError, and a missing projectId or id becomes the text 'undefined' in the path.

inputs.name: browserProjects.api
inputs.description: The client the methods call through; only its get and send members are used, with root-relative /api/ paths. It is read when a method is called, not when browserProjects is called, so a null or undefined value throws a TypeError at that call.

outputs.name: invitationLink
outputs.description: The invitation URL: the origin, then /invite/, the percent-encoded projectId, a slash and the percent-encoded id. Encoding leaves UUIDs unchanged, and the invitation code is never included.

outputs.name: browserProjects
outputs.type: { list: () => Promise<ProjectSummary[]>; get: (projectId: string) => Promise<ProjectSummary>; create: (input: { name: string; repositoryId: number; }) => Promise<ProjectSummary>; members: (projectId: string) => Promise<Member[]>; invite: (projectId: string, input: { email: string; role: Exclude<Role, "owner">; }) => Promise<Invitation>; accept: (projectId: string, invitationId: string, code: string) => Promise<ProjectSummary>; github: () => Promise<GithubStatus>; repositories: () => Promise<GithubRepositories>; }
outputs.description: An object of eight methods (list, get, create, members, invite, accept, github, repositories) that each return the promise from api.get or api.send for a /api/projects or /api/github route. Permissions are decided by the server, which binds every request to the signed-in person; this object performs no checks of its own.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: Thrown synchronously by encodeURIComponent when a project or invitation id contains an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate, in invitationLink or in the browserProjects get, members, invite and accept methods; no request is sent.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when invitation is null or undefined in invitationLink, because projectId and id are read from it, or when api is null or undefined in a browserProjects method, because the method then reads api.get or api.send.

errors.name: ApiFailure
errors.description: A rejection from api.get or api.send that this unit does not catch, so it reaches the caller unchanged; BrowserApi declares ApiFailure with a numeric status and a string code.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: Thrown synchronously by encodeURIComponent when the invitation's projectId or id contains an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate, so no link is returned.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when invitation is null or undefined, because projectId and id are read from it before the link is built.
